## First Horizon Bank Names Andrew Finkle Palm Beach and Broward County, Florida Market President


November 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/903615748/files/doc_news/First-Horizon-Bank-Names-Andrew-Finkle-Palm-Beach-and-Broward-County-Florida-Market-President-2026.pdf)


BROWARD COUNTY, Fla., Nov. 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") today announced Andrew Finkle as Palm Beach and Broward Market President, leading the local team and serving the bank's clients across the greater Palm Beach and Broward County, Florida region.


Finkle previously served as First Horizon's Commercial Banking Team Lead for Broward and Palm Beach Counties. He has more than 25 years of experience in commercial and investment banking in addition to five years as the CFO of a middle-market wholesale distribution company.


"Andrew is a trusted leader whose experience and commitment to our clients will serve Palm Beach and Broward counties well as Market President," said Marty Lanahan, South Regional President for First Horizon Bank. "His focus on service excellence, the community and our associates is central to how he leads every day."


Finkle joined First Horizon in 2016 and has played a key role in driving the growth of the market's commercial banking portfolio. He is also recognized for developing a talented team of commercial bankers who share a commitment to serving clients and supporting surrounding communities.


**About First Horizon** First Horizon Corp. (NYSE: FHN), with $84.3 billion in assets as of September 30, 2026, is a leading regional financial services company, dedicated to helping our clients, communities and associates unlock their full potential with capital and counsel. Headquartered in Memphis, TN, the banking subsidiary First Horizon Bank operates in 12 states concentrated in the southern U.S. The Company and its subsidiaries offer commercial, private banking, consumer, small business, wealth and trust management, retail brokerage, capital markets, fixed income, and mortgage banking services. First Horizon has been recognized as one of the nation's best employers by Fortune and Forbes magazines and a Top 10 Most Reputable U.S. Bank. More information is available at[www.FirstHorizon.com](http://www.firsthorizon.com/) .
